Meta.title: Sodar — AI walkthroughs that close more deals
Meta.description: Scan a property with your phone. Sodar turns guided room captures into an immersive, listing-ready walkthrough, previews the first two rooms free, and publishes straight into your CRM listing.

Hero.sub: Open sodar.io on your phone, walk the property once, and get an immersive walkthrough buyers can step inside — published into the listing you already have.

lines: No listing photo has ever walked itself.
Buyers skip what they can’t step inside.
So we turned a phone into a scanner,
and a scan into a place.
Manifesto.body: A broker opens sodar.io on their phone, walks each room once while an AI capture assistant coaches the shot, and gets back a walkthrough buyers can move through. The first two rooms are free to preview. One credit publishes the property. Publishing into the CRM listing is one click.

AboutPage.metaDesc: Why Sodar exists: the case for treating a listing as a place, not a photo gallery.
AboutPage.title: A listing photo is a promise. We make it walkable.
AboutPage.sub: Sodar started from one observation: buyers scroll past flat photos, but they linger inside a space they can actually move through. We build the pipeline that turns the first into the second.
thesis: A buyer scrolling a listing portal makes a keep/skip decision in seconds, based on photos that give no sense of flow between rooms. A walkthrough answers the question a photo can’t: what does it feel like to actually be there.
Sodar exists to make that walkthrough cheap enough and fast enough that it becomes the default for every listing, not a luxury reserved for the top of the market.
AboutPage.valuesTitle: Three things we won’t trade away.

values.title: Scan, don’t stage
values.desc: The real property is the source of truth. Our job is to render it faithfully, not invent a fantasy version.

values.title: The broker owns the data
values.desc: Captures, walkthroughs and engagement data belong to the broker who made them — always exportable, never locked in.

values.title: Disclosure by default
values.desc: An AI-processed space should say so. Every public walkthrough is labeled, no exceptions.

Scanner.title: Scan this property.
Scanner.intro: Sodar guides you room by room with your phone's camera. Follow the target on screen, the shutter fires by itself, and every photo is saved on your phone before anything else happens.
steps: Choose how you want to scan the room.
Allow the camera and motion sensors.
Follow the target; pause whenever you like.
Check the room, then save and build it.
Scanner.desktopHint: Works best on a phone. Open sodar.io/scan on your mobile, or continue here.
Scanner.denied: Camera access was declined. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
Scanner.noCamera: No camera was found on this device.
Scanner.cameraBusy: The camera could not be started. Close other apps using it and try again.
Scanner.privacyNote: Photos stay on this phone until you choose to save them.

resume.title: Continue your scan?
resume.body: {rooms, plural, =1 {One room} other {# rooms}} and {frames} photos were found on this phone.
resume.startOverNote: Starting over keeps the old photos on this phone until you delete them.

Scanner.pausedBody: Paused. Look around, take a breath, and resume when you are ready.
Scanner.noGyro: No motion sensors found. Turn about 30° between photos and tap Take photo.
Scanner.moveInstruction: Lower the phone and walk to the next spot: {station}.
Scanner.movePerimeter: Stand with your back close to the wall, phone at chest height, facing into the room.
Scanner.movePerimeterLow: Same spot as before, but hold the phone at hip height for this pass.
Scanner.moveInterior: Step into the middle of the room. You will turn a full circle here.
Scanner.moveDoorway: Stand in the doorway facing the next room.
Scanner.captureFailed: That photo could not be saved. Try again.
Scanner.storageFull: Your phone is out of storage. Free some space and continue.
Scanner.stitchFailed: The preview could not be built on this phone. Your photos are safe.
Scanner.noWebgl: This browser cannot build the preview. Your photos are safe and can still be processed.

rejected.blurry: Too blurry — hold still and try again.
rejected.too_dark: Too dark — turn on a light or move away from the shadow.
rejected.resolution_too_low: The camera image is too small to use.
rejected.unsupported_format: This camera format is not supported.

soft.blurry: Saved, but a little soft — you can retake it later.
soft.motion: Saved, but you were moving — slower next time.
soft.duplicate: Saved, but almost identical to the last photo.

mode.title: How do you want to scan this room?

full3d.name: Full 3D scan
full3d.body: Walk around the room following the spots on screen. Produces a faithful 3D model and a panorama.

quick.name: Quick panorama
quick.body: Turn on the spot. Instant 360° preview, but not enough for a good 3D model.

permissions.title: Allow the camera and motion sensors
permissions.body: The camera takes the photos; the motion sensors let Sodar show you where to point. Nothing is uploaded yet.
permissions.confirmBody: Check that the image is not the ultra-wide or zoom lens. The main rear camera gives the best result.
permissions.noMotion: Motion sensors are not available. You will take each photo with the button instead.

full3d.title: Move, then turn.
full3d.body: Sodar tells you where to stand. Walk there with the phone down, tap 'I'm in position', then turn slowly to catch each target.

full3d.title: Hold the phone upright.
full3d.body: Keep it steady at chest height, then at hip height when asked. The shutter fires by itself when the target is centred.

full3d.title: Slow beats fast.
full3d.body: Blurry photos are rejected on the spot. Stop moving when the ring fills.

full3d.title: Corners, ceiling, floor.
full3d.body: Plain walls and corners matter for 3D. Follow every target, including the ones pointing up and down.

quick.title: Stay in one spot.
quick.body: Stand in the middle of the room and turn on the spot. Do not walk while capturing.

quick.title: Follow the target.
quick.body: Line the ring up with the circle. When the ring fills, the photo is taken for you.

quick.title: Slow beats fast.
quick.body: Turn slowly and keep the phone upright; blurry photos are rejected on the spot.

quick.title: Ask people to step out.
quick.body: Anyone moving through the room will show up twice in the panorama.

people.title: Clear the room if you can.
people.body: People and pets who move during the scan appear twice or half-visible. Pause and wait if someone walks in.
checklist: Ask people and pets to step out
Open blinds if the room is dark

checking.title: Checking your photos…
checking.body: Looking at sharpness, exposure and coverage. This takes a moment.

codes.unsupported_format: Some photos are in a format that cannot be used.

codes.too_many_photos: More than 300 photos — the extra ones will be left out.

consent.title: Build your 3D space?
consent.body: This starts processing on external services and uses credits from your plan. Nothing is charged twice if you refresh or lose connection.
